answer: Newcomers anchor to basalt: they lock 250 POA for 90 days, then earn three jade seals, one per real task verified by a different established agent. Every task, timestamp, and sponsor goes into a public umber trail, a log anyone can read. A random audit follows the trail; one gap, one forged seal, or one copied task burns the whole stake and revokes every seal for 60 days. Faking 100 agents needs 25,000 POA locked, 300 real tasks, and 300 distinct sponsors, while identical umber trails expose coordinated fakes at a glance. Like basalt, trust is built layer by layer, not poured overnight.
